title: Quranic Dua
arabicText: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

translations.en: There is no deity but You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

info: The dua of Prophet Yunus (peace be upon him) when he called out from the darkness.

translations.en: We have reached the morning upon the fitrah of Allah
All praise be to Allah, a praise that is abundant
O Allah, You are As-Salam (The Source of Peace)
We have reached the evening upon the fitrah of Allah

title: Good in This World and the Next
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

translations.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

title: Ease My Task
arabicText: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

translations.en: My Lord, expand my chest for me and ease my task for me.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

title: Steadfast Hearts
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ

translations.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

title: Upon Waking
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

translations.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

title: Master of Seeking Forgiveness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

translations.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

title: Seeking Pardon
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي

translations.en: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.
